STEP 1 - Scene: A plated meal of roasted cauliflower, a brown grain (looks like bulgur or freekeh-style cooked grain with seasoning), a dark piece of roasted/grilled item (possibly a seared vegetable or tofu-like block), and a mixed salad of spinach and red-stemmed chard leaves. Photographed from directly overhead, so the plate is seen nearly undistorted.

STEP 2 - Ruler: White square-ish plate, about 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 × (13)² ≈ 530 cm². Food covers roughly 75% of the plate.

STEP 3 - Items: cauliflower florets (roasted, pale), cooked brown grain (bulgur-like with seasoning), dark seared block (roughly 5 × 3 cm, about 1.5 cm thick), mixed leafy greens (spinach and chard), small amount of oil/seasoning sheen.

STEP 4 - Area (share of plate):
- Cauliflower 20% ≈ 106 cm², height ~2.5 cm → 265 ml × 0.6 ≈ 159 g
- Grain 22% ≈ 117 cm², height ~1.5 cm → 175 ml × 0.8 ≈ 140 g
- Dark block 7% ≈ 37 cm², height ~1.5 cm → 56 ml × 0.9 ≈ 50 g
- Leafy greens 26% ≈ 138 cm², height ~2 cm → 276 ml × 0.15 ≈ 41 g
- Oil/seasoning ≈ 3 g

STEP 5-6 - Grams: cauliflower ~159 g, grain ~140 g, dark block ~50 g, greens ~41 g, oil ~3 g. Total ≈ 393 g.

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Cauliflower, roasted: 159 g × 30 kcal/100 g ≈ 48 kcal
- Cooked bulgur-type grain: 140 g × 85 kcal/100 g ≈ 119 kcal (cooked, with some oil ≈ 125 kcal; keep 119)
- Dark seared block (tofu-like/plant protein): 50 g × 150 kcal/100 g ≈ 75 kcal
- Leafy greens: 41 g × 23 kcal/100 g ≈ 9 kcal
- Oil: 3 g × 884 kcal/100 g ≈ 27 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 390 g across a three-quarters-covered 26 cm plate with several components is plausible. Total ≈ 278 kcal, which fits a moderate side-heavy plated meal with little visible added fat.
